name: Dengdai Fuchou Ri
source:
The story takes place in a fictional world of sword and sorcery. The protagonist, Amelia, comes from a powerful family of magicians, yet she was exiled due to her abysmal magical aptitude. After being forced to move into a haunted house, she encounters the ghost of its former owner, and the story begins.

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4849180/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在一个剑与魔法的架空世界。主角阿米莉亚出身于强大的魔法师家族，却因糟糕透顶的魔法天赋而惨遭驱逐。被迫搬进一栋鬼屋后，她邂逅了这栋房子原主人的鬼魂，故事也由此拉开帷幕。

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4849180/]Steam[/url]]
